meta.title: Magpie real route
meta.description: Show the real upstream model behind a magpie routing group directly below the composer (the text follows the DSH UI language: "magpie real route" in English, "magpie 真实路由" in Chinese). The dock line refreshes every 15 seconds and on click; it reads the package Host half's same-origin route /plugins/magpie-route/route, so the browser never calls the gateway directly. Read-only: it sends no model request and does not change routing; the magpie gateway must be running. In-flight requests without usage are counted but not reported as a route. The dock shows the latest settled request across DSH sessions because DSH does not send X-Magpie-Session. No configuration is required: it uses the default gateway http://127.0.0.1:3425; only if your gateway runs elsewhere, override baseURL in cordis.patch.yml. This plugin adds no command and no agent tool.
